source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This rule gives your army 2 benefits:

- 1 extra pick per battle of the **assault doctrine** or **tactical doctrine**.
- +1 to **[advance rolls](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** for **ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER** units of yours.

Your **SUBODEN KHAN** units have **Wrath of the First Khan**: as each [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) ends, you may use it if the unit has been **eligible to fight** in that phase. If you do:

- If **unengaged**, it may make a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**.
- If **engaged**, it may make a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**.

**Restrictions**: **WHITE SCARS** units are allowed, but **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units from any other Chapter are not.

grants.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 3 of 73 ability grants of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
